summary: A 4-day Seoul shopping and K-pop adventure exploring trendy districts, flagship stores, entertainment landmarks, cafes, and modern lifestyle spaces in Hongdae, Seongsu, Gangnam, and Jamsil.

days.theme: Hongdae youth culture and K-pop shopping

pois.name: Hongdae Walking Street (홍대 걷고싶은거리)
pois.notes: Experience street performances, K-pop dance covers, fashion boutiques, and the energetic atmosphere of Hongdae.

pois.name: AK Plaza Hongdae (AK플라자 홍대)
pois.notes: Shop for K-pop albums, character goods, cosmetics, and Korean fashion near Hongik University Station.

pois.name: Mecenatpolis Mall (메세나폴리스몰)
pois.notes: Explore a modern shopping complex with fashion brands, cafes, and lifestyle stores.

pois.name: Kakao Friends Hongdae Flagship Store (카카오프렌즈 홍대 플래그십 스토어)
pois.notes: Purchase popular Korean character merchandise and enjoy photo opportunities with giant character displays.

pois.name: Hongdae Club Street (홍대 클럽거리)
pois.notes: Walk through the nightlife district known for music culture, performances, and trendy local shops.

days.theme: Seongsu creative shopping and trendy cafes

pois.name: Seongsu Cafe Street (성수 카페거리)
pois.notes: Discover industrial-style cafes, designer boutiques, and Seoul's latest lifestyle trends.

pois.name: Musinsa Store Seongsu (무신사 스토어 성수)
pois.notes: Browse Korean street fashion brands and trendy apparel popular among young locals.

pois.name: Seongsu Yeonbang (성수연방)
pois.notes: Explore a stylish complex featuring local brands, cafes, and creative lifestyle shops.

pois.name: SM Entertainment Seongsu Building (SM엔터테인먼트 성수 사옥)
pois.notes: Visit the surrounding area of the entertainment company's building, a popular spot for K-pop fans.

pois.name: Cafe Onion Seongsu (카페 어니언 성수점)
pois.notes: Relax in a famous factory-style cafe known for its pastries and unique industrial interior.

days.theme: Gangnam luxury shopping and K-pop entertainment

pois.name: COEX Mall (코엑스몰)
pois.notes: Shop at one of Asia's largest underground malls featuring fashion, beauty, and entertainment stores.

pois.name: SMTOWN@coex Artium Area (SMTOWN 코엑스 아티움 주변)
pois.notes: Explore a famous K-pop area associated with SM Entertainment and popular among fans.

pois.name: K-Star Road (강남돌 K스타로드)
pois.notes: Walk along a street decorated with GangnamDol sculptures representing famous K-pop artists.

pois.name: Apgujeong Rodeo Street (압구정 로데오거리)
pois.notes: Enjoy premium Korean fashion, beauty stores, designer boutiques, and celebrity hotspots.

days.theme: Jamsil entertainment, shopping, and iconic Seoul experiences

pois.name: Lotte World Mall (롯데월드몰)
pois.notes: Explore a massive shopping complex with luxury brands, K-pop stores, beauty shops, and restaurants.

pois.name: Lotte World Adventure (롯데월드 어드벤처)
pois.notes: Enjoy Korea's famous indoor theme park with attractions, performances, and entertainment.

pois.name: Seoul Sky (서울스카이)
pois.notes: Finish the trip with panoramic views of Seoul from one of the world's tallest observation decks.
